financings_after_balance_sheet.what: ATM sales of common stock under the Jefferies Sales Agreement in October 2024 (exact day not given; month-end used)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: In October 2024, the Company sold 1,526,610 shares of its common stock pursuant to the Sales Agreement at a weighted-average price per share of $26.20 and received net proceeds of $38.6 million

warrants.quote: Pre-Funded Warrants to purchase 1,071,505 shares of the Company's common stock were used in the calculation of the weighted-average common shares outstanding
